text:
𝗗𝗜𝗣𝗨 𝟭𝟬𝟯*! 🔥

Bangladesh A were 33/2 in the Rising Stars semi-final. Shahadat Hossain Dipu hit 103* off 118, ton on the penultimate ball, to reach 232/8.

Pakistan A need 233.
#Cricket #BANvPAK

facebook.caption:
𝗗𝗜𝗣𝗨 𝟭𝟬𝟯*, 𝗔𝗞𝗘𝗟𝗘 𝗞𝗔𝗟 𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗚𝗟𝗔𝗗𝗘𝗦𝗛 𝗔! 🔥🏏

👉 Rising Stars semi-final mein BAN-A 33/2 par atki thi
👉 Shahadat Hossain Dipu: 103* off 118 gend
👉 Sau aakhri se pehli gend par, team 232/8 tak pahunchi
👉 Pakistan A ko jeetne ke liye 233 chahiye

Aapke hisaab se ye total kaafi hoga ya Pakistan A nikaal legi?

#CricketKiBaat #RisingStars #BANvPAK
